message.content: Based on the conversations provided, LiHua enjoys playing "Black Myth: Wukong" both solo and with friends. Specifically, LiHua mentions enjoying the game's storytelling and the opportunity to play with friends, saying, "I’m also hooked on the storytelling. It’s cool how it reimagines the classic tale with such depth. Any favorite character so far?" and "How about you? Anyone you’re vibing with?" Later, LiHua expresses enthusiasm for playing co-op, stating, "Any epic moments you’ve had while playing? I love that balance. It's refreshing to switch between action and thinking. Makes every session feel different." Furthermore, LiHua invites ThaneChambers to shop for games together, suggesting, "Hey Li Hua! 🎮 Are you up for some shopping together this weekend? Just saw that the local game store has some killer discounts on PS5 games! Let me know! 😊". These exchanges clearly indicate that LiHua prefers the social aspect of gaming and enjoys playing "Black Myth: Wukong" with others.
